name: Voice LLM gateway and idle GPU lease manager
purpose: public OpenAI-compatible voice LLM API on :8100; tracks request activity, offloads vLLM weights to host RAM after 300 seconds idle, reads global GPU metrics to let GPU1-only coding continue while voice wakes on GPU0, and waits for any dual-GPU Flash Next lease to expire naturally
installedBy: hosts/gpu-195/install.sh (rootless podman quadlet, user powos, linger on)
autosleep: vLLM /sleep?level=1 after 300 seconds without gateway API requests; /wake_up on next request; dual-GPU lease waits up to 30 minutes for Flash Next's natural TTL unload, while GPU1-only sessions are not interrupted
gpu: none; coordinates GPU0/GPU1 lease with llm-pool
